newsitem.title: USA: Managed High Yield sees more debt demand.
newsitem.headline: Managed High Yield sees more debt demand.

text.p: Managed High Yield Fund Inc said Monday it expected the bull market in high-yield corporate debt to continue amid moderate economic growth, low interest rates, a booming stock market, new institutional demand and company consolidations.

The fund, which primarily invests in high-yield, high-risk debt securities, said its largest position was in media companies's corporate debt in the second quarter. It added it held substantial positions in telecommunication companies' bonds. The fund said U.S. dollar-denominated emerging market corporate debt performed especially well during the quarter.
